title: ichnocarpus andamanica
intro: Ichnocarpus andamanica, commonly known as the Andaman island starflower, is a plant species found in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and it has been found to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Ichnocarpus andamanica include its potential to treat fever, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
